The main takeaway from our work is that
cloud providers can enforce SLA compliance on client enclaves without sacrificing the confidentiality and integrity guarantees offered by SGX.
SGX enclaves are not necessarily completely opaque, and that cloud providers can leverage the SGX architecture to ensure that enclaves satisfy their SLAs.
SGX enclaves are a promising platform for cloud clients to host their applications in the cloud.
